title: No text in generated pictures
statement: Keep words and labels out of generated images and video frames.
detail: The look rules of an intro-video BrainLift for a Grade 3 reading course include no text in generated frames (`downloads/BrainLift - What makes a good intro video.md`, line 965), and the course's image prompts say the same: no text or labels in the image (`downloads/5. Curriculum/Instruction/3.1 - Fantasy Classics - Lesson Designs/3.1 - 2. Aladdin and the Wonderful Lamp, Part 2 (FICTION, INFER) — v3 (new INFER design).docx`, line 60 of its text) and no text baked into the art (`downloads/5. Curriculum/Instruction/3.2 - The Living World - Lesson Designs/3.2 - 1. The Wonderful World of Plants - FIND - Lesson Design (v2 - MCQ pauses + science sweep).docx`, line 44). No outcome was measured.
